quote: indicated for the long-term, twice daily (morning and evening) maintenance treatment of bronchoconstriction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
note: Adversarial reading is that bronchoconstriction is the target and COPD the population, but the section is headed 'Maintenance Treatment of COPD' and managing the disease's airflow limitation counts as managing COPD; the negation only covers acute deteriorations and asthma.

quote: Relieves sinus congestion and pressure, helps decongest sinus openings and passages
note: The edge names the symptom itself (sinus congestion), which multiple OTC phenylephrine labels list as the thing relieved, so no symptom/disease swap applies.

quote: Active lupus nephritis who are receiving standard therapy
note: Lupus nephritis is named directly as an indicated condition on both FDA and EMA text; the CNS-lupus limitation does not touch it.

quote: solid tumours expressing a neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) gene fusion, who have a disease that is locally advanced, metastatic
note: EMA text names NTRK-fusion solid tumours as the treated condition; the advanced/metastatic qualifiers only narrow the population within that disease.

The edge disease is an unresolved UMLS code with no label, so I cannot tell from the supplied text which condition is being asserted (the only indication present is multidrug-resistant HIV-1 infection).

quote: LIVDELZI is indicated for the treatment of primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) in combination with ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA)
note: PBC is the named treated disease; the combination/monotherapy and decompensated-cirrhosis limitations do not negate it.

quote: For the temporary relief of general anxiety, sleeplessness, depression, muscle and joint pain and digestive discomfort
note: Thin OTC/homeopathic-style text, but 'relief of general anxiety' names anxiety itself as the thing relieved rather than as a symptom of another disease, so FP2 does not clearly apply; most other carbonate labels (antacids, iron) are irrelevant.

quote: temporarily relieves these symptoms due to hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies: runny nose itchy, watery eyes sneezing itching of the nose or throat
note: Hay fever is allergic rhinitis and the label treats its symptom complex, which the rubric counts as managing the disease rather than a symptom swap.

quote: Pulmonary Diseases Acute exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) Allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis Aspiration pneumonitis Asthma
note: Asthma (and bronchial asthma under Allergic States) is a named item in the list of indicated conditions.

quote: Community-acquired pneumonia due to Chlamydophila pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae, Mycoplasma pneumoniae or Streptococcus pneumoniae in patients appropriate for oral therapy
note: CAP is a named indication; the limitation of use only excludes patients inappropriate for oral therapy and does not negate the indication.

quote: Tinidazole is indicated for the treatment of bacterial vaginosis (formerly referred to as Haemophilus vaginitis, Gardnerella vaginitis, nonspecific vaginitis, or anaerobic vaginosis)
note: Bacterial vaginosis is explicitly named as a treated indication.

quote: treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic gastric, esophageal, or gastroesophageal junction cancer as a component of a combination chemotherapy regimen
note: Esophageal cancer is a named item in the indicated list; the stage qualifier narrows the population but the disease is the target.

quote: Treatment of Wilson's disease.
note: EMA text names Wilson's disease as the sole treated indication.

quote: prevention and treatment of hyperuricaemia in adult patients undergoing chemotherapy for haematologic malignancies at intermediate to high risk of Tumor Lysis Syndrome
note: Haematologic malignancy is only the population/setting; the thing treated is hyperuricaemia.

quote: Temporarily relieves these symptoms due to the common cold, hay fever (allergic rhinitis) or other upper respiratory allergies
note: The label names allergic rhinitis explicitly and treats its symptom complex, which counts as managing the disease; the antihistamine symptoms are attributable to mepyramine even in combination products.
ADHD or any attention/behavioural condition is not mentioned anywhere in the thyroid label text, which covers only hypothyroidism, goiter and thyroid cancer.

quote: Adjunctive treatment of focal-onset seizures with or without secondary generalisation in adult patients with epilepsy
note: Focal-onset seizures in patients with epilepsy is a subtype of epilepsy and the thing treated, so the narrower-than-edge granularity favours TARGET rather than a population reading.

quote: For the prevention of recurrence following rheumatic fever and/or chorea: Prophylaxis with oral penicillin on a continuing basis has proven effective in preventing recurrence of these conditions.
note: Chorea is named as a condition whose recurrence the drug prevents, and prevention counts; 'choreatic disease' is a close parent of chorea rather than a whole organ-system class, so FP4 is not warranted.

quote: symptomatic nonerosive gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). erosive esophagitis due to GERD, diagnosed by endoscopy.
note: GERD is a named treated indication across multiple famotidine labels.

quote: Imipenem and Cilastatin for Injection, USP (I.V.) for intravenous use is indicated for the treatment of lower respiratory tract infections caused by susceptible strains of Staphylococcus aureus
note: All text is from the imipenem/cilastatin combination, but the label describes imipenem as the penem antibacterial and cilastatin only as a dehydropeptidase inhibitor, so the LRTI indication belongs to imipenem; 'recurrent' LRTI is a narrower form of LRTI.
HIV is not mentioned anywhere; the gentian violet text is limited to first-aid prevention of skin infection in minor cuts, scrapes and burns.

quote: indicated for use in combination therapy with a luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone (LHRH) analog for the treatment of Stage D 2 metastatic carcinoma of the prostate
note: Stage D2 metastatic prostate carcinoma is a subtype of prostate cancer; the 150 mg negation concerns a dose/regimen, not the disease.

quote: Myocardial Infarction Propranolol hydrochloride is indicated to reduce cardiovascular mortality in patients who have survived the acute phase of myocardial infarction and are clinically stable.
note: Adversarial reading is that MI survivors are the population and mortality the endpoint, but the indication is headed 'Myocardial Infarction' and is post-MI management of that same disease, unlike the rubric's FP1 example where a different disease is the setting.

quote: gastrin secretion to aid in the diagnosis of gastrinoma
note: Secretin is a diagnostic stimulation agent; gastrinoma is the condition being diagnosed, not treated.
The supplied EMA biosimilar texts list breast, NSCLC, renal and ovarian/fallopian/peritoneal cancers only; colorectal cancer (or colon/rectal) is not mentioned anywhere in the supplied text.

quote: Buprenorphine Sublingual Tablets are indicated for the treatment of opioid dependence and are preferred for induction.
note: Opioid dependence is named on single-ingredient buprenorphine labels and EMA text, so it is attributable to buprenorphine and not only to the naloxone combination.
Anorexia nervosa, appetite or eating disorders are not mentioned anywhere; the ascorbic acid text covers only multivitamin/fluoride dietary supplementation and caries prophylaxis.

quote: Neupro is indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of early-stage idiopathic Parkinson's disease as monotherapy
note: Parkinson's disease is explicitly the treated condition in the EMA text; treating its signs and symptoms is management of the disease.

quote: Lyrica is indicated for the treatment of peripheral and central neuropathic pain in adults.
note: Neuropathic pain is named directly as the treated indication.

quote: indicated for the treatment of tinea cruris and tinea corporis caused by Trichophyton rubrum, Trichophyton mentagrophytes, Epidermophyton floccosum, and Microsporum canis
note: Tinea cruris is the standard term for dermatophytosis of the groin/perianal region, so the edge matches the indicated condition.

quote: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory Philadelphia chromosome positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia (Ph+ ALL).
note: Ph+ ALL is a subtype of acute lymphoblastic leukemia and is a named indication on both FDA and EMA text.

quote: indicated in adults for the treatment of community-acquired pneumonia (moderate severity only) caused by beta-lactamase producing isolates of Haemophilus influenzae
note: All text comes from the piperacillin/tazobactam combination, but tazobactam is a beta-lactamase inhibitor and the antibacterial activity against H. influenzae is piperacillin's own, so the CAP indication is attributable to piperacillin.

quote: indicated for the treatment of CMV retinitis in patients with acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS)
note: AIDS is only the patient population; the treated condition is CMV retinitis (and acyclovir-resistant HSV), not AIDS itself.

quote: indicated for the relief of symptoms of depression. Endogenous depressions are more likely to be alleviated than are other depressive states.
note: Depression is the treated condition and the label explicitly singles out endogenous depression as the form most likely to respond, so the edge is a named subtype rather than a swap.

quote: when requirements are increased as in fever, severe burns, increased metabolism, pregnancy
note: Fever appears only as a state that raises vitamin requirements (the setting for parenteral vitamin supplementation); the drug does not treat or manage the febrile disorder.

quote: symptomatic treatment of endometriosis in women with a history of previous medical or surgical treatment for their endometriosis
note: EMA Ryeqo names endometriosis as the treated condition and the FDA Myfembree text manages pain of endometriosis; relugolix is the GnRH antagonist responsible for the effect, with estradiol/norethindrone as add-back, so no co-ingredient issue.

quote: Uses treats migraine
note: Several acetaminophen OTC entries state 'treats migraine' outright; although the other labels are opioid combinations for acute pain, the union of texts names migraine as a treated condition.
